_note: The salon's booking rules. Every time the website offers, and every booking it makes, goes through these (api/_booking.js), and the WhatsApp and phone assistants will use the same file. People are listed by their first name as it appears in Phorest. Times are London time, 24-hour. Leave a rule out to have no limit. Rebuild after changing: node sites/beauty-heaven-hub/build.mjs

_help.confirmOnSite: true lets clients confirm on the website. Also needs BOOKING_LIVE=on in Vercel. Keep false until the data agreement is signed and a dummy-client test has passed.
_help.minNoticeHours: no bookings sooner than this many hours from now
_help.maxDaysAhead: no bookings further ahead than this
_help.everyone: rules for all practitioners: startFrom (earliest start), finishBy (treatment must end by), days (e.g. ["Tue","Wed"])
_help.people: the same rules for one person, overriding everyone. byDay sets a different start or finish for one weekday, e.g. {"Thu": {"finishBy": "20:00"}}
_help.deposits: treatment sections (titles as on the website) that need a deposit, e.g. {"Semi-permanent make-up": true}. Phorest's deposit settings set the amount.
_help.teamOnly: treatment sections the website never confirms itself (it offers WhatsApp or a call instead). Consultation-first and prescription-only sections are always team-only.
